video-cog 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launch of CellCog-powered AI video generation skill.
- Supports creation of marketing, explainer, educational, documentary, cinematic, UGC, and news-style videos.
- Enables lipsync and spokesperson videos with AI-generated voice and character presentations.
- Includes comprehensive usage guide, example prompts, and video specifications.
- Requires CellCog mothership skill for setup and API integration.
